topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: When I heard the accusation, my heart sank, but I knew I had to approach this with care and understanding. I asked the student to sit down with me in a quiet corner, where we wouldn’t be interrupted. I listened as they spoke, their voice trembling, and I nodded, ensuring they knew I was there to support them. We went through their work together, gently pointing out similarities and discussing the importance of proper citations. I shared resources that could help them, and we made a plan to review the guidelines together. My hope is that this will be a learning opportunity, a chance for them to grow and feel empowered rather than defeated.
